options: Ask the Head of Road Works for a repair schedule.

fields.condition: Many streets in East Ward have no working street lights after dark, and people there avoid walking in the evening.
fields.affected: Evening commuters and older residents of East Ward, size unknown, who avoid the streets after dark.

observed_facts.statement: The lighting fault list shows 38 street lights out in East Ward in the autumn report.

uncertain_claims.statement: The outages may share one fault.
uncertain_claims.why_uncertain: The fault list does not link the outages to a cause.
uncertain_claims.what_would_settle_it: The repair log of the lighting team for East Ward.

sources.establishes: The count of street lights out in East Ward in the autumn report.

causal_hypothesis.statement: Repairs are slow because the repair team is understaffed and the fault list is ignored (hypothesis, untested).

fields.scope: Street lighting, road surface, bus stops and parks in all wards of the city, since before the last election.
fields.desired_outcome: Every service in every ward of the city works at night and in the day, and anyone can read all logs.

final_acceptance_criteria.statement: Fewer than 5 street lights out in East Ward.
final_acceptance_criteria.how_observed: The public fault list, read at the end of the period.

assumptions.statement: The repair budget is not the limit.
assumptions.how_to_check: Read the published lighting budget line.

fields.reason: I read the volunteer note. The wording is mine and I keep it for now; I will explain in the reply.

fields.scope: Street lighting in East Ward since October last year; not other utilities and not other wards.
fields.desired_outcome: Every street in East Ward is lit at night and anyone can read the repair log.
